title: 22 — Flavor Story / "Tastes Like"
description: A photorealistic close-up food scene fills the entire background (raspberry donuts, chocolate cake, caramel drip). A headline at the top promises "Tastes like [indulgence]". The product sits casually dropped into the scene at a tilt. A stat bar at the bottom handles nutrition compliance ("15g protein / 2g sugar / 180 cal"). Works for health-forward food / supplement brands that taste indulgent.
